experiments.evidence: Revert confirmed, wider than the engineer checked. Bytes: all 48 art/out/fighters GLBs cmp identical to ac10d5386^ (loop over git show), 0 carry vale_orm_grade, working tree clean for that path, no commit touches it after 8668fb29a. Client: 48 of 48 catalog-referenced assets in dist-catalog/assets are byte-identical to art/out and none of the 48 graded hashes is referenced by schema-1/2026.10.1/catalog.json (the engineer checked Vashil only). Own same-page frames at new seeds and moments, ORM bytes swapped live on every fighter on the field (10 fighters, 10-25 materials); 6-7 fighter teamfights except where noted: rift High s311 t1185, rift Ultra s397 t877, bridge High s277 t721, fray High s359 t309 (the fight had drifted to about 2 fighters in frame by capture), rift Low s311 t1185; each at fight, with telegraphs, and at 31 m, plus 5 Collection stages (vashil, vashil_first_bell, vashil_chalkline, marund, nurrow). Results in _harness/_shots/gfx_verify_GFv2/diff.json, report_*.json, script v2.mjs, gitignored. Now vs pre-grade bytes: 0 px >8 in 14 of 15 game frames and all 5 stages. The one exception, bridge z31, has 1 px, and now vs a second capture of the same variant gives the identical count (1 px, 18 px >0), so it is page noise, not the asset. Control that the capture can see the grade: now vs graded 129-1863 px >8 (0.006-0.090 % of the frame) in play, 7263-19087 px >8 on the stages. Looking at actual size as a player (look_rift, look_bridge, look_fray): I cannot tell graded from reverted in play, so the revert loses nothing visible. On the stage the revert is plainly better: the brown vertical streaks on vashil_first_bell and vashil_chalkline are in the graded column and gone from the current one (look_vfb.png, look_vcl.png); the engineer had framed only base vashil. Motion: frozen-sim pan flickEdge is equal or very slightly lower on the reverted tree (rift High 23.444 vs 23.457, Ultra 22.988 vs 22.991, bridge 23.074 vs 23.075, fray 17.831 vs 17.834, Low 22.297 vs 22.306), and repeat pans are identical; 4 consecutive real sim frames on both variants move in either direction, with no pattern (rift High 48.144/46.681/31.945 vs 48.064/46.334/32.086 on the changed pixels). Telegraphs, team rings and hue: identical to pre-grade by the 0 px result on the tele frames at High, Ultra and Low. Budgets: triangles, draws and programs equal across variants in every frame (peak fight here 351362 / 192 / 39 rift High; texture count rises in the page only from my probe's extra textures). perf_1080 --prod on this tree (_harness/_reports/gfx_verify_GFv2_perf.json): GATE PASS, match peak 454k triangles, 253 draws, 40 programs, 0 programs first seen after 1:00. value_probe rift, bridge, fray on High and Low (_harness/_reports/gfx_verify_GFv2_value.json): 88 PASS, 0 FAIL, laneP50 87-91, fighterTop25 79.8-83. Memory: memMaps peak 2242 MB renderer + GPU in match, Home 1473 MB, passes; this is one run under load, and I did not reproduce the 2715-2983 MB harness, so nothing here replaces the ruling 20 gate. With byte-identical GLBs there is no asset delta to measure. Timing: load 4.1-6.6 during captures, 5-8.5 during perf_1080, so all timing is not_measured (perf_1080 itself says machine busy). typecheck and content:check are clean. Tool: glb_orm_regrade.py has no --grade, --check, stamp or budget, and glb_data_maps_swap.py's imports from it still resolve. The engineer's 0 px and the 'no required rebuild step' claim hold. Stage and game renders I looked at show no sensitivity change: the art is the pre-grade art.

summary: Pass: nothing is kept in GF. The GF-1 revert is clean, and GF-2 and GF-3 stay rejected. All 48 fighter GLBs and their 48 client catalog assets match ac10d5386^ byte for byte. New frames on rift, bridge and fray at High, Ultra and Low show 0 px >8 against the pre-grade bytes beyond page noise (1 px on one frame, equal to the same-variant control). In play nobody can tell the grade was removed, and on the stage the Vashil robe streaks are gone, including on first_bell and chalkline, which the engineer had not framed. Budgets hold: perf_1080 --prod count gate passes (454k triangles, 253 draws, 40 programs), and value_probe gives 88 PASS, 0 FAIL. Memory read 2242 MB match and 1473 MB Home in memMaps, one run under load, not the 3.0 GB gate. Limits: all timing is not_measured at load 4-8.5; of 48 GLBs, 10 were on the field in frames and 5 stages were framed, the rest rest on byte identity; the fray fight had thinned to about 2 fighters in frame by capture. Correction to verdict 1: the grade did change Low fighter pixels (761-950 px >8), so its 'Low unaffected' was wrong; this no longer matters after the revert. Not GF, seen in passing, for the lead: (1) a tall dark tapered shape with a violet glowing tip, about 240 px high, in _harness/_shots/gfx_verify_GFv2/rift_high_s311_tele_now.png at about (1020,800) and (1350,660), appears identically on all variants; source not identified, it looks like an effect, not a hood, and I make no ruling 7 finding, but someone should look at it against ruling 7. (2) memMaps reads 41 programs on the fourth sequential match (match_4_rift), above the 40 budget; the single-match gate reads 40, earlier memMaps runs reached 42 on bridge, and the same-page counts here show GF adds none. Paths: the brief names both _design/reviews/gfx/GF_verify2.json and _design/reviews/fixwaves/GFX_GF_verify2.json; I wrote only the fixwaves file, as its closing instruction says and as earlier verdicts do.
